system.flavor: You were made for the shot no one else would take.

system.flavor: You never loose twice from the same spot: a step to the side, and the line is clean again.
system.automationNote: the Field Boon in the roll dialog when you have left your square this turn since your last [Strike] Action (or since your turn began): tracked from your token's moves. With it, the Archer's Starting Mastery: 5 with one Projectile weapon (the Mastery tab's choice; book, Mastery).

system.description: Special: You make this Strike with a Light weapon you hold.

system.flavor: You shift the bow to one hand, open a foe with the knife, and are gone before it turns.

lines.label: Special
lines.text: You make this Strike with a Light weapon you hold.

system.automationNote: the Strike, Staggered (EoT) on a Tier 3, then the Evade 2 (the button); drawing and stowing the Light weapon by hand (the hands buttons).

versions.effects: You @Move[evade|distance:2].

system.flavor: You loose arrow after arrow into one foe before the first has landed, and step away while it reels.
system.automationNote: 2[W] / 3[W] by Tier, the Evade 2 (the button); a Critical's 1 AP back by hand.

system.trigger: The target would enter a square adjacent to you.
system.flavor: A foe lunges for you, and you put an arrow in it before it has finished the step.
system.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when an enemy would enter a square adjacent to you (Move back: it stops before that square); Use: the shot, Hindered (EoT) on a Tier 2, Immobilized (EoT) on a Tier 3.

versions.effects: Your allies perceive the target one step better than they do: Hidden as Obscured, Obscured as Clear; Unsensed stays Unsensed (1 round).
Your next [Ranged, Strike] Action this turn ignores the Banes of far and maximum range, and counts each target's Cover as one level lower (Total Cover stays Total).
Against each creature you have Cover from, your Cover is one level higher, up to High (1 round).

system.flavor: You read the field the way others read a page: where a foe hides, where the gap in its cover is, where you yourself are hardest to hit.
system.automationNote: the Mode's pick; Call Out: the target is Called Out (1 round: its enemies perceive it one step better); Find the Gap: an effect on you (no far or maximum range Bane on your next [Ranged, Strike] this turn; its Cover one level lower by hand); Keep Low: an effect as a reminder (by hand).

system.description: The @Book[Leaning]{Leaning} Action costs you 0 AP.
system.flavor: A wall is a quiver's best friend: you are out, the arrow is gone, and you are back.
system.automationNote: Leaning costs 0 AP while your Escalation is 2 or more.

system.requirements: You haven't left your square this turn.
system.flavor: You hold your ground until your foe shows its flank, and put a broad-headed arrow where the wound will not close.
system.automationNote: its Requirement checked on your turn in a combat (you haven't left your square: your token's moves); the shot, Lingering 1 / Lingering 2 (Bo/In) by Tier.

system.flavor: You strike with the weapon in your hands.
system.description: You attack with the weapon you are wielding. Weapon Attack takes the Melee or Ranged trait of that weapon, and its Range.

lines.label: Special
lines.text: You attack with the weapon you are wielding. Weapon Attack takes the Melee or Ranged trait of that weapon, and its Range.

system.flavor: You press forward, one deliberate step at a time.

versions.effects: You move up to your Speed in squares, in one piece: the movement you don't use is lost (you can't move part of it, use another Action and move the rest later). Once during this Advance, at any point of the movement, you can use the Interact Action (paying its 1 AP then) and go on moving. @Move[advance|distance:speed]

system.flavor: You slip through the fray without giving anyone an opening.

versions.effects: @Move[evade|distance:1]: a movement that doesn't trigger reactions, in one piece; you can't Evade into or through Difficult Terrain.
@Move[evade|distance:floor(speed/2)]: a movement that doesn't trigger reactions, in one piece; you can't Evade into or through Difficult Terrain.

system.flavor: You work the mechanism and seat a fresh bolt.
system.requirements: You or an ally within Reach is wielding an unloaded weapon.

versions.x1: Your next Reload attempt gains 2 Boons.
versions.x2: You Reload the weapon. Then you can Regrip (1A) to hold the weapon with two hands, or the ally can. @Reload[weapon] @Regrip[weapon|label:Regrip (1A)]
versions.x3: You Reload the weapon and its wielder can @Move[evade|distance:1]. Then you can Regrip (1A) to hold the weapon with two hands, or the ally can. @Reload[weapon] @Regrip[weapon|label:Regrip (1A)]

system.flavor: You pull the lever, open the door, grab what you need.

versions.effects: You do one of the following: draw an object you carry into a free hand; stow an object you hold (put it away on your person, such as sheathing a sword); swap two objects (stow the one you hold and draw another, in the same Action); grab objects within Reach, as many as you have free hands; help a Prone creature within Reach stand up; help an Imperiled creature within Reach get to safety; wake an Unconscious creature within Reach; open a door, chest or something similar. This Action is broader than most: it can be used for similar things in the world. You can use it once during an Advance Action without ending the Advance (see @Book[Advance]{Advance}).

system.flavor: You grit your teeth and find a little more to give.
system.description: You can't use this Action while Down (Desperate, Dying or Shattered) or Unconscious.
system.special: You can't use this Action while Down (Desperate, Dying or Shattered) or Unconscious.

versions.effects: You use @Rally[1].

system.flavor: You drag yourself along the ground.

versions.effects: You move 1 square. @Move[advance|distance:1|label:Crawl 1]
Requirements: Your Speed is 5 or higher. You move 3 squares. @Move[advance|distance:3|label:Crawl 3]

system.flavor: You shift your hands on the grip, and the weapon sits where you want it.

versions.effects: You do one of the following: hold a weapon you hold in one hand with both hands (your other hand must be free); move a weapon from one hand to the other; or swap the weapons in your two hands. Regrip doesn't have the Handle trait: it doesn't need a free hand. @Regrip[weapon]

system.flavor: You let it go.

versions.effects: You drop an object in your square, or let go of an object you hold with one hand (a two-handed weapon is then held with one hand). @Release[weapon]

system.flavor: You get your feet back under you.

versions.effects: You stand up: you are no longer Prone.

system.flavor: You tear loose from whatever holds you.
system.requirements: You are Immobilized.

versions.effects: You are no longer Immobilized, and no longer Grabbed if you were. When the card that Grabbed you says so, make a Body or @Check[instinct] (the higher) against the holder's Immobilized DC first: below it, you stay @Condition[grabbed]{Grabbed}.

system.flavor: You close the distance in one straight, reckless line.
system.requirements: You have at least Speed 3.

versions.effects: Advance in a @Book[Straight Line]{straight line} toward the target, at least 3 squares and up to your Speed, and stop on the first square from which the target is within your Reach. You can't Charge through Difficult Terrain (an unwilling creature's space is Difficult Terrain), even if you have movement left: the Charge ends in the last empty square where the line is legal. At the end of your movement, make a Weapon Attack (1A) with 1 Boon against the target. That Weapon Attack counts toward At-will Banes. @Move[charge|distance:speed+2*has(Battering Charge)|min:3|uncapped:yes|label:Charge] @Use[Weapon Attack|boons:1|empowered:has(Battering Charge)|atwill:yes|label:Weapon Attack (1A, 1 Boon)]

system.flavor: You lean out from cover, just enough to see.

versions.effects: Until the end of your turn, you calculate cover from one of your corners instead of the center of your square, and your own cover against other creatures' Actions is reduced by 1 level. You can stop Leaning at any time on your turn, at no cost. Click a corner of your square on the map to choose which one you lean toward: your token peeks out a little past it (so you can see around a wall that ends there, and you are more exposed too), unless a wall is in the way. Click it again to go back to the center. @Condition[leaning|eot]

system.flavor: When there is nothing else in your hands, there are always your hands.

system.flavor: You take them by the arm and put them where you want them.

system.flavor: A hooked foot, a twist, and they hit the ground.
system.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.

system.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.

system.flavor: You snag them and drag them in.

durgan.name: Durgan (Dwarf Paladin, Lay On Hands, level 1)

system.description: You stand in front so the others can stand back. A holy warrior who judges a foe before their god, shields the allies near them, and, when the fight has built long enough, brings all of it down in one blow.
system.flavor: Your god's strength flows through your weapon and your hands.

system.description: Judged: A creature stops being Judged when it goes Down. A creature Judged by you counts as Profane for you. Once each round, when it damages an ally within 5 squares of you, you can reduce that damage by your Power Modifier. Multiple Paladins can Judge the same creature: it is Judged by each of them.

versions.effects: The target is Judged by you until the encounter ends.
versions.special: You can use this only at the start of an encounter, or as a 0R when the creature you Judged goes Down.

versions.effects: The target is Judged by you until the encounter ends. If another creature was Judged by you, it no longer is.

system.flavor: You pronounce a foe guilty before your god, and holy light dulls its blows against those who stand near you.

lines.label: Judged
lines.text: A creature stops being Judged when it goes Down. A creature Judged by you counts as Profane for you. Once each round, when it damages an ally within 5 squares of you, you can reduce that damage by your Power Modifier. Multiple Paladins can Judge the same creature: it is Judged by each of them.

settings.text: choose a creature to Judge. Target it and use Judge:
{mark}, the creature you Judged, went Down. Judge another (0R): target it and use Judge:

system.automationNote: the mark (the ring on the token), Profane for you (Smite's and Word of Radiance's d8s, your Profane rules), once each round, the Judged creature's damage to an ally within 5 squares of you reduced by your Power Modifier if you choose (you're asked when it lands), the reminders at the start of an encounter and when it goes Down; the 0 AP use only at the start of an encounter or as a 0R: by hand.

msg.text: choose a creature to Judge. Target it and use Judge:
{mark}, the creature you Judged, went Down. Judge another (0R): target it and use Judge:

system.autoHover: At the start of each encounter, it can use Judge once for 0 AP; posts “choose a creature to Judge. Target it and use Judge:” to its owners and the GM. When the creature it marked goes Down, it can use Judge once for 0 AP; posts “{mark}, the creature you Judged, went Down. Judge another (0R): target it and use Judge:” to its owners and the GM.

system.flavor: Holy light gathers on your weapon as the fight wears on, and you bring all of it down in one blow.

system.flavor: You drag yourself along the ground.

versions.effects: You move 1 square. @Move[advance|distance:1|label:Crawl 1]
Requirements: Your Speed is 5 or higher. You move 3 squares. @Move[advance|distance:3|label:Crawl 3]

system.flavor: You shift your hands on the grip, and the weapon sits where you want it.

versions.effects: You do one of the following: hold a weapon you hold in one hand with both hands (your other hand must be free); move a weapon from one hand to the other; or swap the weapons in your two hands. Regrip doesn't have the Handle trait: it doesn't need a free hand. @Regrip[weapon]

system.flavor: You let it go.

versions.effects: You drop an object in your square, or let go of an object you hold with one hand (a two-handed weapon is then held with one hand). @Release[weapon]

system.flavor: You get your feet back under you.

versions.effects: You stand up: you are no longer Prone.

system.flavor: You tear loose from whatever holds you.
system.requirements: You are Immobilized.

versions.effects: You are no longer Immobilized, and no longer Grabbed if you were. When the card that Grabbed you says so, make a Body or @Check[instinct] (the higher) against the holder's Immobilized DC first: below it, you stay @Condition[grabbed]{Grabbed}.

system.flavor: You close the distance in one straight, reckless line.
system.requirements: You have at least Speed 3.

versions.effects: Advance in a @Book[Straight Line]{straight line} toward the target, at least 3 squares and up to your Speed, and stop on the first square from which the target is within your Reach. You can't Charge through Difficult Terrain (an unwilling creature's space is Difficult Terrain), even if you have movement left: the Charge ends in the last empty square where the line is legal. At the end of your movement, make a Weapon Attack (1A) with 1 Boon against the target. That Weapon Attack counts toward At-will Banes. @Move[charge|distance:speed+2*has(Battering Charge)|min:3|uncapped:yes|label:Charge] @Use[Weapon Attack|boons:1|empowered:has(Battering Charge)|atwill:yes|label:Weapon Attack (1A, 1 Boon)]

system.flavor: You lean out from cover, just enough to see.

versions.effects: Until the end of your turn, you calculate cover from one of your corners instead of the center of your square, and your own cover against other creatures' Actions is reduced by 1 level. You can stop Leaning at any time on your turn, at no cost. Click a corner of your square on the map to choose which one you lean toward: your token peeks out a little past it (so you can see around a wall that ends there, and you are more exposed too), unless a wall is in the way. Click it again to go back to the center. @Condition[leaning|eot]

system.flavor: When there is nothing else in your hands, there are always your hands.
system.requirements: You have a free hand.

system.flavor: You take them by the arm and put them where you want them.
system.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours. The target must remain within your Reach throughout the whole movement.

system.flavor: A hooked foot, a twist, and they hit the ground.
system.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.

system.flavor: You put your weight behind it and drive them back.
system.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.

system.flavor: You snag them and drag them in.
system.requirements: Your Reach is 2 or more. The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours and is at least 2 squares away. The target must remain within your Reach throughout the whole movement.

system.flavor: You beat out the flames, press on the wound, scrape off what burns.
system.targets: You, or one Lingering creature within your Reach

versions.effects: The target makes a Save against its Lingering, with the better of the Lingering's two Attributes, against DC 13 or the DC the Lingering writes. Tier 1: no effect. Tier 2: it takes half the Lingering at the end of the current turn (whoever's turn it is), then the Lingering ends. Tier 3: the Lingering ends. @ShakeOff[save]

system.description: Armor 14 (11 + 3). Rare. Needs Heavy Armor Training.
